purpose: Derive Node/NVM and Gradle runtime hints after the existing Project Tree scan completes; do not run a second root scanner.

controls.label: Project Root Runtime Hints from Project Tree Scan
controls.scope: Start Project Root / Project Tree scan -> Create header runtime fields
controls.scan_policy: Reuse build_project_scope / Project Tree scan results. Inspect only marker files already present in file_references, such as .nvmrc, .node-version, package.json, gradle-wrapper.properties, settings.gradle, build.gradle, gradlew and gradlew.bat.
controls.ui_policy: Do not start a second filesystem crawl. Project Tree scan remains the only scan entrypoint and reports through the shared loadingbar/progress status.

contract: When Start Project Root / Working Tree changes, call the existing Project Tree scan path.
After that scan completes, derive runtime hints from the returned scope file_references.
Do not execute project build commands while deriving hints.
Resolve Node/NVM from .nvmrc, .node-version or package.json engines when those files are already in the scope.
Resolve Gradle from gradle-wrapper.properties or existing Gradle markers when those files are already in the scope.
Apply detected values to Create header runtime fields and dependency/compiler rows.

operation_roles.label: Create Project Root Runtime Hint Operator
behavior: Treat the Project Tree scan as the point of truth for Start Project Root runtime evidence.
Do not introduce parallel scanners for the same root-change event.
Prefer project-declared runtime versions over broad system guessing.
Never infer shell execution commands from runtime marker files.
